exposure: GDM diagnosis (ADIPS1998 criteria vs. IADPSG criteria)
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
International Association of Diabetes Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
Australasian Diabetes in Pregnancy Society 1998 criteria (ADIPS1998)
Women not meeting ADIPS1998 criteria for GDM
finding: Among women not currently treated for GDM, obesity was associated with greater pregnancy risk than GDM diagnosed by IADPSG criteria.
mod_finding: The study found that women diagnosed with GDM using IADPSG criteria had an increased risk of induction of labor and large for gestational age infants but did not specifically analyze mode of delivery as a predictor.
